faq.a: The site advertises free single-scene analysis and limited multi-scene access. Quotas differ between the public pricing copy and the live interface; verify the allowance shown before submitting.

faq.q: What is the upload size limit?
faq.a: The homepage FAQ lists 20 MB and recommends compression or trimming for larger clips. Confirm the current upload form before preparing a file.

faq.q: Can I analyze a YouTube link?
faq.a: Yes, the public interface provides a YouTube link tab. We checked the interface, not the extraction quality or availability for every URL.
No. The .app domain is a separate website with its own plans, upload interface and scene modes.

faq.q: What does the privacy policy say?
faq.a: The FAQ points to the privacy policy for collection, processing and retention. Read that policy before sending private footage; do not assume uploads are entirely local.
